'''Jhantoria''' was a celestial body<ref name="Xim" /> located in the [[Jhantoria system/Legends|Jhantoria system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a part of the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]],<ref name="Xim" /> situated within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> Jhantoria was the origin point of [[Jhantorian wine]].<ref name="Lianna">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Jhantorian wine]]|system=[[Jhantoria system/Legends|Jhantoria system]] and specifically Jhantoria|legends=1}}</ref> By [[25,130 BBY]], the astronomical object was situated within the borders of the confederation of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] known as the [[Livien League]]. At some point around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the forces of [[King of Cron|King]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] of the [[Kingdom of Cron]] [[Battle of Jhantoria|defeated]] those of the Livien League at Jhantoria.<ref name="Xim" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jhantoria was introduced in<ref name="Xim" /> the [[December 7]], [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]<ref name="XimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek01/index.html|text=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> article "[[Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster]]" by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Xim" /> The [[August 18]], 2009<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Jhantoria [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square S-6.<ref name="TEA" />
